notes: - **`backfill_model_track`** — reconstructs what a model WOULD have concluded at past dates, so the accountability machinery (forecast scoring, re-underwriting, the model-gap chart) has evidence now rather than in three years. It had exactly one snapshot before this. - **The rules are absolute, not aspirational.** A statement is usable at a date only if it was **filed** by then — fiscal period end is not knowledge, so FY2024 ending 31 December is invisible until its February filing.
